photato_api.lifecycle: Normalized source includes layer/sample mode and ignores selection-only edits. Edits/tool changes/sample/layer/refresh/cancel/read/close invalidate IDs; API additionally checks permission/revision/lifecycle and cache at commit.

model.author: Google / MediaPipe; Adel Ahmadyan
model.input: NHWC1x256x256x3 RGB, mean/std127.5; source-aligned half-pixel bilinear resize; transparent pixels over black.
model.conversion: Independent bounded TFLite-to-CoreML MIL graph reconstruction; float32 MLProgram macOS14. Runtime is Swift/CoreML/Vision only; Python dependencies offline development-only.

model.known_quality: Google model card explicitly excludes pixel-perfect masks; small256grid, fine facial labels unsupported. Model output is not Adobe proprietary segmentation equivalence.
